items.text: This review is long overdue and more than worthy of the five stars. We have been extremely impressed with Banks pools along the entire journey from design all the way through to completion. I can be a bit picky at times, but Hoyt and his team are just as, if not more critical of their own work and it shows.
Have always been treated well by Roger and everyone at Banks. Pool is 10 years old and still working great. Weekly cleaning is always done right.
These may be some of the most helpful people in the state of Kansas. They are responsible for some truly state-of-the-art creations
Great Company I love how they finish the work on time and very professionally. Even my cat liked it!!
